attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept. Create ONE static game art concept by editing the provided current-tile reference. This reference is the user's actual approved in-game tile, NOT a loose inspiration. Preserve the exact blue-grey stone tile, top diamond 4:3 projection, tile scale, original framing, visible masonry side faces, camera and proportions. Do not replace or redesign the terrain. Image must show the COMPLETE SAME tile with the new hazard spread across its ENTIRE TOP FACE. Keep a generous transparent margin all around. Only add the hazard and small local light/contact accents on the top; do not add props or characters. No text, labels, panels, extra tiles, borders, UI, grass or pedestal redesign. Clean coherent pixel-art colour clusters matching the reference, no extra coarse pixel grid, no blur, no noisy photorealism. The entire top surface must read as hazardous from back vertex to front vertex and from left corner to right corner; NOT just a small central symbol or spot. No hazard down the vertical side faces. True transparent background. Keep the composition centered and the complete asset inside frame.
VARIANT DIRECTION: Scatter 28 small loose ninja makibishi/tetsubishi CALTROPS across the WHOLE upper diamond in an organic irregular distribution reaching all four corner zones. Each is a separate forged dark iron tetrahedral four-pronged object: three feet visibly resting ON the stone, one sharp point up, randomly rotated. Small cool silver edge highlights. No straight rows. No spikes growing out of ground, no holes, no pressure plate, no mounted traps, no giant central spike. Consistent small size, believable clear four-prong geometry, full-tile distribution with stone visible between objects.
attempts.status: rejected during independent review: regular grid placement; superseded
